is_anopheles.evidence: The paper models insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae populations across Africa (e.g., Title: 'A mathematical model for mapping the insecticide resistance trend in the Anopheles gambiae mosquito population under climate variability in Africa').

reports_target_markers.evidence: No target resistance markers are genotyped. The authors state: 'we quantified the evolution of IR using a time-varying population R0 for female mosquitoes, ignoring differences in genotypes' (page 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele frequencies/counts are reported or generated in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquitoes were sampled or tested by the authors; the model uses secondary validation data downloaded from the WHO Malaria Threat Map database.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a theoretical mathematical modeling paper using a compartmental SIR framework, validated using previously published bioassay records from the WHO Malaria Threat Map.

sub_country_location.evidence: No primary sampling sites are established; maps show continental-scale model predictions.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Validation dataset aggregated historical bioassay data from 2000 to 2019 across Africa.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable as this is a theoretical modeling paper that does not report new empirical specimens.

supplement.evidence: The supplementary material contains model parameter tables (PRCC analysis) and not primary field mosquito genotyping data.

assessment.summary: This is a mathematical modeling study that adapts a susceptible-infected-resistant (SIR) framework combined with climate variables (rainfall, temperature) to model insecticide resistance dynamics in Anopheles gambiae. It contains no primary molecular genotyping or field collections.
exclusion_reasons: Pure modeling paper / not a primary empirical study
Does not report target insecticide resistance markers
No primary African field mosquito collections tested
